Bajaj Auto Shares Rise on Strong Q1 Profit Report

Bajaj Auto's shares reached a 52-week high for the second consecutive day on July 21, following the company's announcement of a 42.3% year-on-year increase in standalone net profit for the first quarter of FY27, reaching ₹2,982.84 crore. This strong performance has led to positive near-term outlooks for the company and TVS Motor.
